parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the cluster IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a specific region.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-health-status --db-cluster-id am-bp1d8lbdj22rx0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
